entity.description:
The , also known as Showroom 3, is a location in Murray's Costume Manor.

Arnold enters the Birthday Showroom for the first time through a broken wall and winds up Jackie's music box. After doing so, the hand cranks comes off and can be used to open a gate.

{|class="article-table" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="text-align:center;"

The entrance of the Birthday Showroom consists of a single room with a giant birthday cake with Mrs. Helpful on top of it. The full room resembles a children's play place, with different types of decorations, cutouts and Jackie as the main attraction.
